title: Luxurious Syrian Chicken Wrap
description: A sweet and snappy Syrian dish featuring panang curry paste, ssam-wrap, and paleo-friendly ingredients, this wrap is a flavorful and indulgent treat. It combines the richness of chicken and curry with the crunch of fresh vegetables.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through.
Add the panang curry paste to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the curry paste is fragrant.
Warm the ssam wrap pieces by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the wraps by slicing the cooked chicken and adding it to the ssam wrap along with the sliced red onion, cucumber, and tomato.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top of each wrap.
